Ford starts the first moving assembly line for cars.
The first controlled nuclear chain reaction is achieved in Chicago.
Christiaan Barnard performs the first human heart transplant.
The ship Mary Celeste is found adrift and abandoned.
Prohibition ends in the United States.
Edison records "Mary Had a Little Lamb" on his phonograph.
Apollo 17 astronauts take the "Blue Marble" photo of Earth.
The US and USSR sign the INF nuclear arms treaty.
Douglas Engelbart demonstrates the mouse in the "Mother of All Demos".
The first Nobel Prizes are awarded.
UNICEF is founded.
Marconi receives the first transatlantic radio signal.
Francis Drake sets off on his voyage around the world.
Roald Amundsen's team reaches the South Pole.
Gemini 6 and 7 make the first crewed space rendezvous.
Colonists dump tea into the harbour at the Boston Tea Party.
The Wright brothers make the first powered aeroplane flight.
The 13th Amendment abolishing slavery is proclaimed.
Charles Dickens publishes A Christmas Carol.
EBR-I becomes the first reactor to generate electricity.
Apollo 8 launches, the first crewed mission to the Moon.
A coelacanth, thought extinct, is found off South Africa.
Bell Labs demonstrates the first transistor.
Apollo 8 orbits the Moon and photographs "Earthrise".
Isaac Newton is born.
Marie and Pierre Curie announce the discovery of radium.
Charles Darwin sets sail on HMS Beagle.
The Lumiere brothers hold the first public film screening.
Richard Feynman gives his "Plenty of Room at the Bottom" talk.
The first colour TV sets go on sale in the US.
The United States hands the Panama Canal to Panama.
